title: MEP Modeler  Discipline : HVAC (Ventilation)
description:
Role Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented BIM Engineer / BIM Modeler with 1–2 years of experience in HVAC (Ventilation) modeling. The ideal candidate should have a Mechanical Engineering  background and hands-on experience in developing accurate BIM models for building services projects. Exposure to international projects will be an added advantage.

Responsibilities:
Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain accurate BIM models for HVAC (Ventilation) systems using  Autodesk Revit MEP.
• Prepare coordinated HVAC models, shop drawings, installation drawings, sections, schedules, and other project deliverables.
• Interpret mechanical and construction drawings, specifications, and project documentation to develop accurate BIM models.
• Coordinate HVAC models with other MEP disciplines (Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection) to ensure clash-free designs using Navisworks and BIM coordination workflows.
• Apply knowledge of HVAC systems, including ventilation, ducting, and piping layouts, while modeling and coordinating projects.
• Ensure compliance with BIM standards, project requirements, Level of Development (LOD), and quality control procedures.
• Collaborate with project teams to incorporate design revisions and deliver projects within defined timelines.

Requirements:
An HVAC MEP modeler needs proficiency in 3D BIM and 2D CAD tools—primarily Autodesk Revit MEP, AutoCAD, and Navisworks—alongside practical knowledge of HVAC system components, clash resolution, and shop drawing production

# Job Description: BIM Engineer

**Company Name:** Prism Infratech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** BIM Engineer  
**Experience Required:** 3–4 Years  
**Location:** Nagpur, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

### Job Summary
Prism Infratech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented BIM Engineer with 3–4 years of professional experience in Building Information Modeling (BIM). The candidate will be responsible for developing, managing, and coordinating accurate 3D BIM models, preparing construction documentation, and ensuring effective coordination between different engineering disciplines.

### Key Responsibilities
1. Develop and maintain detailed 3D BIM models for building and infrastructure projects.
2. Create and modify BIM models using Autodesk Revit and other relevant BIM software.
3. Prepare 2D drawings, layouts, sections, elevations, and construction documentation.
4. Coordinate with architectural, structural, and MEP teams.
5. Perform clash detection and resolve model coordination issues.
6. Ensure BIM models comply with project standards and client requirements.
7. Review drawings and models to identify design discrepancies.
8. Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and BIM coordinators.
9. Maintain model quality, accuracy, and project delivery timelines.

### Required Skills & Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Diploma degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
- 3–4 years of relevant BIM industry experience.
- Strong knowledge of Autodesk Revit.
- Working knowledge of AutoCAD and Navisworks.
- Understanding of BIM workflows, modelling standards, and coordination processes.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering and construction drawings.
- Knowledge of clash detection and BIM coordination.
- Good communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.

### Preferred Skills
- Knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
- Experience working on international BIM projects.
- Knowledge of LOD requirements and BIM execution plans.
- Experience in multidisciplinary BIM coordination.

- Opportunity to work with experienced BIM professionals.

title: SketchUp Modeler
description:
Job Overview:
UBP.ONE is looking for a SketchUp Modeler with around 1- 2 years of experience to join our growing team. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of 3D modeling, architectural drawings, and visualization using SketchUp. This role involves creating accurate 3D models based on design concepts, CAD drawings, and project requirements. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Create and modify 3D models using SketchUp based on architectural or design drawings. 

Convert 2D drawings into detailed 3D models. 

Apply basic materials, textures, and components to models. 

Collaborate with designers, architects, and project teams to understand modeling requirements. 

Maintain organized model files and project documentation. 

Make revisions to models based on feedback from the team. 

Ensure models are accurate and aligned with project specifications. 

Required Skills: 

Basic to intermediate knowledge of SketchUp. 

Understanding of architectural drawings and 3D visualization. 

Knowledge of AutoCAD (basic) is an added advantage. 

Good attention to detail and accuracy. 

Ability to work in a team environment and meet deadlines. 

Qualifications: 

Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, or related field. 

1-2 years of experience in SketchUp modeling or similar 3D software. 

Preferred Skills (Optional): 

Knowledge of V-Ray, Lumion, or Enscape for rendering. 

Basic understanding of interior or architectural design concepts.

Responsibilities:
Your Role: 
Create high-quality 3D models using SketchUp for interior spaces, furniture, fixtures, and products.
Develop accurate 3D models based on architectural drawings, design concepts, and project requirements.
Understand interior layouts, materials, dimensions, textures, and design details to ensure modeling accuracy.
Collaborate with architects, interior designers, and BIM teams to deliver design-focused 3D models.
Prepare detailed 3D models for design development, visualization, and client presentations.
Work with supporting software such as AutoCAD, 3ds Max, and Blender.
Use rendering and visualization software such as V-Ray, Corona Renderer, D5 Render, Enscape, Lumion, or other relevant rendering tools.
Create realistic interior renders with proper lighting, materials, textures, and detailing.
Develop 3D walkthrough animations and camera sequences for interior spaces and architectural projects.

Requirements:
Hands-on experience with rendering tools such as V-Ray, Corona Renderer, D5 Render, Enscape, or Lumion.
Basic understanding of interior or architectural design concepts.
Develop 3D walkthrough animations and camera sequences for interior spaces and architectural projects.

title: Structural Engineer
description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented *Structural Engineer* with *1–2 years of experience* to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, detailing, and coordination of various structural projects while ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards.

Responsibilities:
* Perform structural analysis and design for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
* Prepare structural calculations, drawings, and design documentation.
* Develop RCC and steel structural designs as per project requirements.
* Prepare and review structural drawings using AutoCAD and relevant design software.
* Conduct load _calculations and ensure structural stability and safety.
* Coordinate with_ architects, civil engineers, MEP teams, and other project stakeholders.
* Review drawings and identify design or construction-related issues.
* Assist in site inspections and provide technical support during construction.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications.
* Maintain accurate engineering documentation and project records.
* Support senior engineers in project planning, design reviews, and technical coordination.

Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in *Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering*.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in structural design and analysis.
* Good knowledge of *RCC and steel structure design*.
* Familiarity with structural analysis and design principles.
* Knowledge of relevant *IS Codes and design standards*.
* Proficiency in *AutoCAD* for structural drawings and detailing.
